rationale: No existing E2E/API spec covers the /config → /api/{org}/config endpoint split. landingPage.spec.js exercises post-login navigation but asserts none of the config bootstrap key-set contract, the full-config version canary, or the menu-rail timing; login-form-validation.spec.js covers form validation, not config loading; logoManagement.spec.js covers the enterprise logo UI, not config loading. The security contract (unauthenticated bootstrap exact-key-set) plus the authenticated full-config load is a brand-new test surface with no sibling spec to append to, so a new GeneralTests spec is warranted.
